images.prompt: A friendly picture-book scene of an ordinary German weekday morning on a small street corner: a woman leaves a bakery with a paper bag of bread rolls, a man in a suit runs for a yellow tram holding a coffee cup, a girl walks a dachshund that pulls hard towards the bakery door, a big round street clock on a pole, a cyclist with a basket of flowers. The clock has no numbers, the shop signs and the tram destination are blank.

A delighted young man walking away from a flea-market stall carrying far too much: a lamp in one hand, a chair upside down on his head, a football under his arm, while his dog trots beside him carrying a small table-cloth bag in its mouth. The seller waves goodbye, amused.

A woman standing at a bus stop in the rain without an umbrella, soaked, holding an empty wallet upside down; next to her a small dog sits perfectly dry under its own little umbrella, looking pleased with itself.

At a train-station luggage pile, an older man in a hat, a woman and a boy all point at the same red suitcase at once, each looking sure it is theirs; a cat sits inside the open suitcase as if it were its own bed.

A man searching his living room for his keys, lifting a sofa cushion and looking underneath; behind his back a dog sits holding the key ring in its mouth, and a cat lies comfortably on his mobile phone on the table.

A kitchen table set for dinner: a fat tabby cat sleeps right in the middle of the table between the plates, while a woman stands beside it with her hands on her hips and a firm look; a small boy in swimming goggles and a towel stands at the door, ready to go swimming.

A young man in pyjamas and one shoe running out of his front door holding a toast in his mouth, glancing in panic at a huge round wall clock; on the windowsill a rooster is still fast asleep. The clock face has hands and tick marks only, no numbers.

A big wall calendar with blank pages hanging in a cosy room; a small dog has pulled several pages off and sits happily in a pile of torn pages, while a woman holds a birthday cake with candles and laughs. The calendar pages are blank, no numbers or writing.

A woman lying in bed in the morning reaching out to switch off a ringing alarm clock, one eye open; at the foot of the bed her dog is already up, standing with her shoes in its mouth and the lead around its neck, ready to go. The alarm clock has hands and tick marks only, no numbers.

A man walking through a park in the rain without an umbrella, carrying a wrapped present under his arm and getting soaked; behind him a small dog runs round and round a tree, happy and dry under the leaves.

A busy small railway platform: a woman with a suitcase hurries towards a waiting train, a man carries a bunch of flowers towards the exit, a boy on a scooter heads for a doctor's door with a big plaster on his knee, and a pigeon walks the other way carrying a tiny ticket in its beak. Signs and the train destination are blank, no writing.

A cosy café table: a polite elderly lady orders from a smiling waiter holding a tray with a coffee cup and a slice of apple cake; under the table her small dog has already ordered its own little bowl of water and wears a napkin. Menu cards are blank.

A weekly market stall seen from the front: a young man carries a huge paper bag overflowing with apples, potatoes, a loaf of bread and a bottle of milk, while the seller in an apron hands him one more cheese wheel; a cat sitting on the scales pretends to be one kilo of something. Price cards are blank, no writing.

A woman in a park confidently giving a command with one raised finger to her dog; the dog sits perfectly — while behind her, her husband has also sat down obediently on the grass, looking confused. A ball lies nearby.

A man on a sofa wrapped in a blanket with a thermometer in his mouth and a hot-water bottle on his head, looking miserable; next to him on the floor his dog lies happily with an empty chocolate wrapper, looking very satisfied. The wrapper is blank.

A family coming home after a weekend trip, tired and happy: the father carries a suitcase and a big pretzel, the mother holds a crumpled map and a bag, the child is asleep on the father's shoulder, and their dog wears tiny sunglasses and carries a postcard in its mouth. The map and postcard are blank.

A cheerful child stacking big wooden toy blocks into a tower, one block in the middle painted orange and standing out; a cat on the side is about to push the top block off with its paw. The blocks have no letters or writing.

A doctor's waiting room: a man with a bandaged head, a woman holding her cheek with a toothache, a boy with his foot in a plaster cast, and in the middle a dog wearing exactly the same head bandage as the man, sitting proudly. Posters on the wall are blank.
